rule_0.statement: THE JOINT-LIMIT REACHABILITY OF THE IN-PLACE RE-PLANT: the in-place hold's law currently guards the ANNULUS (the Cartesian reach, fore_env_ticks); it must also guard the JOINT WALLS. THE DERIVATION (Rule 1 -- every number measured on the byte-exact baseline 481f9f56 on this lane BEFORE any edit, from a per-tick fore mining pass in gait_unit.cpp with the controller's control law untouched): the wave-22 death state held its TARGET inside the joint range (the target's shoulder margin 0.0467 rad at the refusal dump) while the ACTUAL shoulder sat 0.0511 rad BELOW the target (the capped servo's deflection under the L hind's 34-37 N rear reaction: the measured 0.3314 N.m restoring torque at the mass-normalized kp) -- the deflection consumed the margin and the substep crossed the -1.6 rad wall: 64 clamp pins at split depth 11. THE ADMISSIBLE REGION: both fore legs hold IK branch -1 (the mined pawcap branches); in the shoulder-local pelvis frame the joint-range region's boundary curves are the circles of radius rho=0.136324 around E(lo1)=L1*(cos(lo1-pi/2),sin(lo1-pi/2)) (and its mirror for the upper wall); ON THE GROUND LINE the region is NOT a behind-wall: the branch's deep-bend pocket makes the MIDDLE inadmissible -- measured at the death line (dy=-0.0733): q1(dx=-0.2414)=-1.551, q1(dx=-0.2359)=-1.593, q1(dx=-0.2204)=-1.748, q1(dx=0)=-1.249: the FORWARD direction from the death seat DIVES THROUGH the wall (the pocket spans dx in (-0.2375,-0.0155) at that line) while the BACKWARD direction restores (-1.551 -> -1.460 at -5.5 mm) and the pocket's far edge is the annulus itself, where the nearly straight arm is jointly admissible (q1 -> psi+pi/2 ~ -1.29). THE DEATH'S OWN ENVELOPE (the one measured constant): kWallMargin = 0.0511 rad = the wave-22 refusal state's target-minus-actual offset (1.59930-1.54817). THE THREE CANDIDATES for the gate-held crux, each derived against the mined trace: (a) THE ADMISSIBLE HOLD/FOLLOW [CHOSEN]: the wall-bound gate-held leg re-plants IN PLACE -- the target slides along the ground line (zero air time, the pad stays in its band) to the seat whose TARGET headroom is 2*kWallMargin, in the authority direction (the +/- 1 mm IK sample; backward at the death window), the annulus bounding the slide; the same wall-bound condition makes the liftoff DUE through the standing no-double-swing gate, and a lift whose SEAT is thin (target headroom < 2*kWallMargin -- the glide's first-sweep transient dives ~0.05 rad below the seat) is DEFERRED one tick so the restored seat covers the transient; the deferral's minimality conjunct: it fires only when the ACTUAL is also wall-bound (a leg whose actual holds a wide margin has nothing to protect -- the mined L@61: seat 0.102162, 3.8e-5 below the bar, actual 0.0867: lifting safe by 7x the transient; the mined R@81: seat 0.022, actual 0.0036: both clauses held and the lift pinned); a sub-contact-band restore (deficit < kTouch = 1e-5 m, the pad's own resolution) is no re-plant at all and the lift proceeds. (b) THE GATE'S PENDING-PRIORITY RE-ORDER [REJECTED, mined]: handing the step to the wall-bound leg re-times the fenced win2 arbitration (at 71 the age rule's winner is the R on its 0.111 rad seat -- the wall-priority would hand 71 to the L and move the named window); the gate's total order is the wave-20 solved machinery. (c) THE FORE LOAD SHARE [REJECTED, measured]: the recede is not skate-driven -- the paw's forward skate (the servo drag) REDUCES the target recede; the dive is CROUCH-driven (the shoulder's descent toward the pad, the mined dy -0.1071 -> -0.0733 over [60,83]); the contact solve owns the normal forces and the controller owns targets -- no lawful knob exists, and removing the skate would accelerate the recede.
